purpose: Discharge step 4 of directives/e256-hardware-architecture.md §5 and constraint H8: build the attack lane as a netlist, prove it recovers planted defects, and report what it finds against reduced-round E256-H together with its cost in LUT6 and cycles.

framing.primary_claim_direction: This gate grades the SEARCH, not the cipher. A calibrated search that finds no distinguisher is not a security result and must never be reported as one.
framing.reduced_round_findings_are_expected: A reduced-round distinguisher is a normal and useful result for an AES-like SPN. Finding one bounds the round count from below; it is not a break of the construction.
framing.planted_positive_requirement: No negative result is reportable unless every planted defect is recovered by the same netlist on the same shared datapath.

exploratory_probe_disclosure.statement: An exploratory Python probe was run before this preregistration was frozen. It confirmed that the integral arm separates the candidate from both planted defects, and that the truncated-differential arm separates the no-diffusion defect.
exploratory_probe_disclosure.consequence: Predictions are stated qualitatively and structurally. The exact round at which the candidate's integral property dies, the exact active-byte progression, all accumulator values, and every cost figure are reported as measured outputs and are deliberately NOT preregistered as numbers.
exploratory_probe_disclosure.reason: Freezing counts already observed in a probe would be post-hoc dressing rather than prediction.

authorization.contract_hash_preimage: all bytes strictly between the unique start and end marker strings, including their surrounding newlines but excluding both marker strings
authorization.allowed: preregistered attack-harness research on non-production RTL

predecessors.inherited: Structural all-to-all byte dependency at round 3, which the truncated-differential arm should reproduce dynamically.
Offset keying is the measured-cheaper scheme, so the attack lane targets the H3 offset rotor.
H3 spectrum certified over the complete offset space, and the certified wiring set containing (0,1,3,4).

questions.text: Does the hardware attack lane recover every planted defect through the candidate's own datapath?
Does the synthesizable attack core compute exactly the same function as the independent software model?
How far does an integral distinguisher reach against reduced-round E256-H, and where does it stop?
What does the attack lane cost in LUT6, flip-flops, and cycles?

toolchain_contract.version_binding: Synthesis and simulation results are tool-dependent, so the recorded version strings enter the deterministic payload.

construction_under_attack.rotor: H3 offset rotor R(x) = SBOX(x XOR p_in) XOR p_out, one per lane per round
construction_under_attack.row_offsets_provenance: member of the certified wiring set from logs/e256-hardware-candidate-gate.json

material.layout: 768 offset bytes as (p_in, p_out) pairs in round-major then lane-major order for 12 rounds by 32 lanes, followed by 416 mask bytes in mask-index-major order for masks 0 through 12
material.note_on_h5_block_size: The H3 scheme needs two offset bytes per lane per round, so its material block is 1184 bytes rather than the 800 bytes recorded for the E256-062 selection scheme. The XOF squeeze-block count is recomputed here rather than inherited.

attack_arms.method: Feed 256 plaintexts that are zero except for an active lane sweeping 0..255, run the round datapath, and XOR-accumulate the ciphertexts. Zero accumulator bytes indicate a surviving balance property.
attack_arms.reported: 32-byte accumulator, zero-byte count, and measured cycle count per (defect, rounds) pair

attack_arms.method: Evaluate the all-zero block and the block with a one-byte difference in lane 0, then count differing output bytes.
attack_arms.reported: active output byte count and both ciphertexts per (defect, rounds) pair

defect_modes.description: planted positive: rotor layer replaced by identity, making the whole permutation affine
defect_modes.detector: integral balance survives at every tested round count

defect_modes.description: planted positive: row shift and MixColumns replaced by identity, isolating the 32 lanes
defect_modes.detector: truncated differential leaves exactly one active output byte at every tested round count

control_execution_contract.requirement: Defect injection must use the same netlist and the same round datapath as the candidate, selected by the defect port. Separate reimplementations are forbidden.
control_execution_contract.equivalence_requirement: Every value emitted by the RTL, for every defect mode and round count, must equal an independently computed software model value. A mismatch means the lane is attacking the wrong function and invalidates the harness.
control_execution_contract.fail_closed: Build an in-memory invalid diagnostic, exit nonzero, and refuse to write or accept the canonical receipt on any contract, equivalence, control, or coverage failure.

cost_contract.synthesis_script: read_verilog <rtl>; hierarchy -check -top <module>; proc; memory; opt; techmap; opt; dffunmap; zinit -all; abc -lut 6; opt_clean; check -assert; stat; ltp -noff
cost_contract.flatten_prohibited: `flatten` must not appear, for the same reason recorded in directives/e256-hardware-cost-preregistration.json.
cost_contract.explicit_limitation: The integral and single cores expose wide flat material ports because this is a research harness; that inflates their mapped cost relative to an engine that derives material on-chip. Only e256h_atk_round is a clean datapath cost.

predictions.statement: the identity_rotor planted defect is recovered by the integral arm at every tested round count
predictions.rationale: an affine permutation must remain balanced; if the search misses this it cannot detect anything

predictions.statement: the no_diffusion planted defect is recovered by the truncated-differential arm at every tested round count
predictions.rationale: lane isolation must be visible as a single active output byte

predictions.statement: every RTL-emitted value matches the independent software model for all defect modes and round counts
predictions.rationale: without bit-exact agreement the lane is not attacking the specified construction

predictions.statement: the candidate's integral balance survives at least 3 rounds and then dies, giving a bounded reduced-round distinguisher
predictions.rationale: expected for an AES-like SPN; the measured reach is the useful output and bounds any future round count from below

predictions.statement: the candidate's truncated-differential active-byte count reaches all 32 bytes by round 3, dynamically reproducing the E256-062 structural dependency certificate
predictions.rationale: cross-checks a static structural certificate against a dynamic hardware measurement

predictions.statement: attack cost is reported in LUT6, cells, logic depth, and measured cycles for every declared module
predictions.rationale: H0 and H8 require attack cost to be measured rather than asserted

hard_rejection_rules: Refuse the receipt if the architecture contract hash, this preregistration hash, any predecessor payload digest, the AES S-box hash, or any pinned tool version drifts.
Refuse the receipt if any planted defect is not recovered by its declared arm.
Refuse the receipt if any RTL value disagrees with the independent software model.
Refuse the receipt if the executed defect-mode set or attack-arm set does not equal the frozen set.
Refuse the receipt if any validity_control prediction (A1, A2, A3) fails.
Refuse the receipt if the synthesis script contains a flatten pass.
Never report absence of a distinguisher as evidence of security, and do not select a round count.

interpretation.scope: two bounded attack arms, one active lane, at most 8 rounds, one key-equivalent material set
interpretation.next: Extend the lane to differential trail search, impossible differentials, meet-in-the-middle, and key recovery before any round count is argued. A round count requires the full attack matrix, not two arms.

non_claims: A calibrated search that finds no distinguisher is NOT a security result; it grades the search.
The reduced-round distinguisher reported here is not a break of the full construction, and no full-round attack is claimed.

Two attack arms are not the attack matrix. Differential clustering, impossible differentials, algebraic and degree growth, meet-in-the-middle, rebound, slide, invariant subspace, related-key and related-tweak, multi-user, reset and reuse, and TMTO are all untested.
Only one active lane, one input difference, and one material set are exercised; no key-recovery attack is implemented.
LUT6 and cycle figures are yosys/ABC and simulation artifacts, not place-and-route, Fmax, energy, or silicon.
No round count is selected and no production keying, wiring, XOF, mode, or RTL is authorized.
No C/H/N row, E256 finding, suite, profile, fixture, or release gate closes here, and reviewed standard AEAD remains mandatory for real data.
